items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, all these shows, like the Steve Allen Show, the Tonight Show.

ctx.x: He was very big stuff in those days. Every day at 5:00 we had this little local radio spot. And then we had one in the club. They called it a remote. Somebody would come from NBC with an engineer and setup and do a half an hour live in the club. All over the country. That’s what helped get me started, was that kind of thing, people hearing us in California. What else? Oh, all these shows, like the Steve Allen Show, the Tonight Show.
The Tonight Show. Dave Garroway, the Today Show?
